subject: reasoning
question:
Two positions of a dice are given below. What will come on the face opposite to the face containing 'R' on it?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4c41b2ba40632e41528e546bee207ebe66dfec0be6a56c2d78820eef43396c3.png]
solution:
As A is the common face on both the dice, keeping it constant and then rotating in clockwise direction, we get the faces opposite to each other:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7734249aeb96083bd1e229101257c203d00d6ee5e9c2d7c1be93cfd9a76ace1.png] 

 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 
P

 
 
 
Q

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 
R

 
 
 
H

 
 
 

 

Clearly, 'P' will come on the face opposite to the face containing 'R' on it.

Hence, '**P**' is the correct answer.
